* Flash Flood Warning for...

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 11 at 8:27AM EDT until August 11 at 10:00PM EDT by NWS State College PA
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in State College has issued a Flood
Warning for the following rivers in Pennsylvania...

Youghiogheny River near Confluence affecting Somerset County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Youghiogheny River near Confluence.

* WHEN...From this morning to this evening.

* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, The right bank of the river overflows
downstream of confluence and about 1/4 mile upstream from the
gaging station.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:45 AM EDT Tuesday the stage was 12.3 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 11.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 13.0 feet
this afternoon. It will then fall below flood stage late this
afternoon.
- Flood stage is 12.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:

through flooded areas.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued by this evening.

are inundated with water and may not be passable. It will take
several hours for all the water from these storms to work
downstream.

Management reports high water along the Cassleman River at
Durst Road, Jennings Road, Dung Hill Road, Bittinger Road,
and Maple Grove Road.
- Additional showers and thunderstorms may reach the area after
11 AM.
